title: 第六千三百一十三章 邪龙成神第六千三百一十二章 圣火玄凰
content_zh:
“那也没关系啊，只要是做了正确的事情，就像是为世界斩杀远古邪龙这样的孽龙，魂飞魄散又怎样？”
永恒炬树苗表现的很是洒脱，让何楚楚都是愣怔在原地。
“我本就是天地蕴养的生灵，为守护众生付出生命，这也是天地愿意看到的吧。”
永恒炬树苗接着说道。
“你真是……让我敬佩了。”
何楚楚沉默片刻，开口说道。
叶枫则是微微一笑，对于永恒炬树苗的觉悟也很欣赏。
此刻，成年永恒炬树已经施展秘法，献祭自身，归还天地。
只见无尽的生机，浩瀚的力量从永恒炬树身上溢散而出，融入周遭的天地中。
原本胜券在屋的远古邪龙，见到这古怪的一幕，突然有种不祥的预感，眉头紧皱的喝问道：“烂树，你在干什么？”
“你看不懂么？”
永恒炬树玩味一笑，接着道：“没关系，你很快就知道我要干什么了。”
“不，不对劲！”
远古邪龙心跳加速，永恒炬树眼下所为，明显是在自废修为，将一切归还天地，气息越来越微弱，要不了多久就会死去。
但这不正常啊，永恒炬树不应该和他拼死一战么，结果自废修为，这太莫名其妙了，绝对有问题。
“不论你在做什么，我不会让你如愿！”
远古邪龙咆哮一声，猛然调动全身力量，张开血盆大口，喷吐出灼热龙息。
“给我死！”
漆黑的龙息散发着滔天邪气，甚至其中还有万千尸骸沉浮，苍白手掌，缥缈鬼影若隐若现。
这龙息所过之处，一切腐朽虚化，就连规则都受到侵蚀，这就是邪龙的力量，他堕落入邪道，变得格外邪恶诡异，力量可以损害世界。

“晚了！”
面对如此可怕的龙息，永恒炬树却是眼神轻蔑，他淡淡开口，已经散去全部修为，连凡人都不如的虚弱身躯缓缓行动。
只见永恒炬树不断掐诀，虚空荡起涟漪，天地在这一刻震颤起来，天空中洒下星光璀璨的雨水，大地亮起莹莹绿光，释放出无限生机。
当星光雨水与无限生机触碰永恒炬树的那一刻，他的气息陡然变化，变得神圣威严，不容侵犯。
“轰隆隆！”
永恒炬树的身形极速膨胀，转瞬间化作顶天立地的伟岸身影，他头顶天，脚踩地，屹立在天地间，一道法轮在他身后徐徐转动，无尽的神威弥漫开来。
“灭！”
永恒炬树一指点出，远古邪龙喷吐的邪恶龙息瞬间凝滞在半空，随后像是画板上的图画一般，被永恒炬树轻轻一挥，便直接抹去，像是从未存在过。
远古邪龙瞳孔骤缩，身躯颤抖，表情崩溃扭曲。
“不，不可能，你，你这是怎么回事！”
“我已经成为神灵。”
永恒炬树缓缓开口，他威严的面容缓缓压下，目光冷漠的注视着远古邪龙，就像在注视一只蝼蚁。
“你造下滔天罪孽，罪不可赦，今日本神便宣判你的死刑，魂飞魄散，永恒抹除！”
“不，你不可能成神！”
远古邪龙崩溃大吼，他知道永恒炬树没有说谎，但他不愿相信，无法接受。
content_en:
"That's okay, as long as you do the right thing, like killing an evil dragon like the ancient evil dragon for the world, so what if your soul is gone?"
The Eternal Torch Sapling acted very free and easy, leaving He Chuchu stunned in place.
"I am a living being nurtured by heaven and earth. I sacrifice my life to protect all living beings. This is what heaven and earth would like to see."
The Eternal Torch Sapling continued.
"You really... make me admire you."
He Chuchu was silent for a moment and then said.
Ye Feng smiled slightly and admired the consciousness of the Eternal Torch Sapling.
At this moment, the adult Eternal Torch Tree has used its secret method to sacrifice itself and return to heaven and earth.
I saw endless vitality, and vast power overflowed from the eternal torch tree and merged into the surrounding heaven and earth.
The ancient evil dragon, who had a chance of winning, suddenly felt an ominous premonition when he saw this strange scene. He frowned and asked, "Rotten tree, what are you doing?"
"Can't you understand?"
Eternal Torch Tree smiled playfully, and then said: "It doesn't matter, you will soon know what I am going to do."
"No, something's wrong!"
The ancient evil dragon's heartbeat accelerated. What the Eternal Torch Tree was doing right now was obviously abolition of its cultivation and returning everything to heaven and earth. Its aura was getting weaker and weaker, and it would not take long for it to die.
But this is not normal. Shouldn't the Eternal Torch Tree fight to the death with him, only to end up destroying his cultivation? This is so inexplicable, there is definitely something wrong.
"No matter what you are doing, I will not let you get what you want!"
The ancient evil dragon roared, suddenly mobilized all its strength, opened its bloody mouth, and spit out burning dragon breath.
"Die!"
The dark dragon's breath exudes a monstrous evil aura, and there are even thousands of corpses floating in it, pale palms, and ethereal ghosts looming.
Wherever this dragon's breath passes, everything decays and becomes hollow, and even the rules are eroded. This is the power of the evil dragon. He has fallen into evil ways and become extremely evil and weird. His power can harm the world.
"Too late!"
Facing such a terrifying dragon's breath, Eternal Torch Tree's eyes were contemptuous. He spoke lightly. All his cultivation had been dissipated, and his weak body, even inferior to that of a mortal, moved slowly.
I saw the eternal torch tree constantly knitting its seals, ripples in the void, the heaven and earth trembled at this moment, starry rain sprinkled in the sky, the earth lit up with a gleaming green light, releasing infinite vitality.
The moment the starlight rain and infinite vitality touched the eternal torch tree, his aura suddenly changed and became sacred and majestic, inviolable.
"Boom!"
The figure of the Eternal Torch Tree expanded rapidly, and in an instant it turned into a majestic figure standing tall against the sky and the earth. With his head in the sky and his feet on the ground, he stood between heaven and earth. A dharma wheel slowly rotated behind him, and endless divine power filled the air.
"Destroy!"
As soon as the Eternal Torch Tree pointed it out, the evil dragon's breath breathed out by the ancient evil dragon instantly froze in the air, and then like a picture on a drawing board, was directly erased by the Eternal Torch Tree with a gentle wave, as if it had never existed.
The ancient evil dragon's pupils shrank suddenly, its body trembled, and its expression collapsed and twisted.
"No, it's impossible, you, what's going on with you!"
"I have become a god."
Eternal Torch Tree slowly opened his mouth, his majestic face slowly lowered, and he stared at the ancient evil dragon with cold eyes, like looking at an ant.
"You have committed heinous sins that are unpardonable. Today, this God will sentence you to death. Your soul will be scattered and you will be wiped out forever!"
"No, you can't become a god!"
The ancient evil dragon collapsed and roared. He knew that the Eternal Torch Tree was not lying, but he did not want to believe it and could not accept it.
